correctness.rationale: For N≥3 the 3-row periodic Moore neighborhood has eight distinct neighbors, so fixedness of middle color i is the count inequality a_(i+1)+b_(i+1)+c_(i+1)≤3. The 10 count types and multinomial weights define the exact 100-state weighted trace B; internal row order is accounted for multiplicatively. Independent reconstruction from the local rule generated 496 edges and exactly verified det(XI-B)=X^45(X-6)P18(X)Q18(X)^2 by integer SymPy characteristic polynomial, with separate brute-force trace counts N=3..6. Strongly connected component analysis gives primitive 72-vertex recurrent component (self-loop) and 6-weight singleton; the given rational Sturm interval isolates λ in (8.6245,8.6246) and it dominates other spectral radii. This proves the all-length zeta/entropy by transfer and Perron theory, not by partial small-N enumeration. N=1,2 must be understood as repeated-position shift periodic points, not eight-distinct-neighbor finite tori.
